title: Slice-isolation hotpatch + customer comms protocol for cross-environment model regressions
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Objective: define and implement an operational protocol that enables fast, low-risk remediation of model rollout regressions across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Scope includes detection-to-resolution choreography: automated slice isolation, KV-cache reconciliation handshake, emergency hotpatch packaging (atomic model swap + config pin), and coordinated customer communications for impacted tenants. Goals: reduce mean time to safe-state for customer-affecting canary regressions to under 20 minutes; enable selective remediation (single-slice rollback or model pin) without global rollback; provide audit trail and post-incident hooks for RCA and billing reconciliation. Out of scope: full rewrite of rollout orchestration, model training fixes, or long-term model quality regression tuning (these will be tracked under rollout-quality initiative). Acceptance criteria: 1) playbook documented and validated in dry-run with SRE and Solutions Eng; 2) end-to-end test that simulates a canary regression and demonstrates slice isolation + KV reconciliation without cross-slice traffic bleed; 3) PR for runtime changes and Console affordance for initiating an isolated hotpatch merged and deployed to canary environment; 4) customer communication templates approved by Support and Legal. Constraints: Private deployments may require ops-runbook variants (no direct control plane access), so we must provide a documented operator checklist for on-prem partners.
comments: 2026-03-05 — Aisha K: Kickoff meeting with SRE, Console PM, and Solutions Eng. Agreed to prioritize slice isolation over full rollback when possible. Action: prototype isolation token by 2026-03-09.

2026-03-07 — Marco L: POC for isolation token implemented in routing service. Token attaches to request meta and triggers per-slice routing table. Initial bench shows negligible added latency (+2ms p95). Uploaded POC logs to internal drive.

2026-03-08 — SRE (Priya Desai): Raised concern about KV-cache divergence when slices use different model checkpoints. Proposed reconciliation handshake: notify runtime to invalidate KVs on target slice and warm from snapshot. Marked as blocker for Dedicated where warm snapshots are large.

2026-03-10 — PM (Jon Reynolds): Reviewed customer comms draft. Requested explicit SLA wording and rollback impact matrix. Draft link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/RUN/ENG-19107+communications.

2026-03-11 — Design (Elena Park): Provided wire for Console action ('Isolate slice + apply hotpatch') and small modal for customer notification opt-in. Design feedback: emphasize operator confirmation step for Private deployments.

2026-03-12 — Marco L: Created runtime PR for atomic model swap and isolation token: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4721. Tests added for routing token and an end-to-end simulation script.

2026-03-13 — QA (Tomás Rivera): Ran canary simulation in staging; observed KV warm failure on 2/30 runs due to snapshot packaging race. Root cause tracked; follow-up ticket created for snapshot locking (ENG-19189).
